content: Memory section name The actual section name is given by the MemorySection . symbol , if this attribute is missing the MemorySection . short- Name is taken as default (this is for backwards compatibility reasons). The section name of each MemorySection instance shall be a part of the so-called memory al- location keyword used in preprocessor statements in the actual code.
